latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the docx skill for professional document workflows.

- Enables comprehensive .docx document creation, editing, text extraction, and analysis, including tracked changes and comments.
- Provides detailed workflows for reading, creating, and redlining professional Word documents.
- Supports both basic and advanced OOXML editing, with guidance on using JS (docx-js) for new documents and Python (Document library) for editing.
- Includes best-practice strategies for handling tracked changes, batch editing, and precise XML mapping.
- Mandates thorough reading of critical documentation files before performing major actions.
